---
title: "FitzHugh-Nagumo Brain Synchronization"
subtitle: "Directed weighted coupling on a 90-region brain atlas"
---

Replicates the [NetworkDynamics.jl Directed and Weighted Graphs tutorial](https://juliadynamics.github.io/NetworkDynamics.jl/stable/generated/directed_and_weighted_graphs/) — FitzHugh-Nagumo oscillators on a 90-region AAL brain connectivity derived from DTI (Tzourio-Mazoyer et al., 2002). The structural connectivity matrix `Norm_G_DTI.txt` provides directed, weighted edges.

## YAML Specification

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import Code, Markdown
Code(filename="yaml/fitzhugh_nagumo.yaml", language="yaml")
```

## Model Report

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("yaml/fitzhugh_nagumo.yaml")
Markdown(exp.generate_report())
```

## Generated Julia Code

```{python}
Code(exp.render_code("networkdynamics"), language='julia')
```

## Run & Plot

```{python}
ts = exp.run(format="networkdynamics")
ts.plot()
```

## Results

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
u_data = ts.data.sel(variable='u')
print(f"Shape: {ts.data.shape}")
print(f"Time range: {ts.time[0]:.1f} – {ts.time[-1]:.1f}")
print(f"u range: [{u_data.min().item():.3f}, {u_data.max().item():.3f}]")
print(f"Final u std across nodes: {u_data.isel(time=-1).std().item():.4f}")
print(f"(Lower std indicates synchronization)")
```

## Animate

```{python}
ani = ts.animate("u", format="dots")
ani.save("fitzhugh_nagumo.gif", writer="pillow", fps=20)
```

![Coupled FitzHugh-Nagumo oscillators on a network, each node alternating between its excitable rest state and a spike.](fitzhugh_nagumo.gif)
